thread:
mira: FYI staging canary failing: helm pre-hook that decrypts SOPS secrets errors out, which prevents pods from starting on the gke-gpu-canary nodepool.

samir: seeing same. error in vault-agent sidecar: TLS handshake failed -> connection reset. started ~2h ago after the infra CI run.

mira: logs: ```time="2026-03-20T10:12:03Z" level=error msg="vault: tls: handshake failure" host=vault-staging.internal:8200```

jules: terraform ran a change earlier that bumped the gpu nodepool autoscaler min from 0 -> 1 in eu-west1. Could be exposing a timing/metadata issue where pod init expects secrets immediately but node provisioning is slower.

samir: I reproduced locally by applying the same helm values. Looks like sealed-secrets controller version mismatch with certs + vault-agent can't reach Vault over the internal VPN for a short window. controller logs show `unsupported payload format` for some secrets.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout: staging/llm-canary: 3/5 hooks passed, 2 failed. checked: pre-hook decrypt failed -> rollback initiated.

ops-jen: cost note: GPUs coming up and flapping — we're seeing short-lived billing hits. estimate ~€350-450/day if this keeps happening in prod. recommend pausing autoscale until fixed.

mira: temporary mitigation: switch CI helm upgrade to use cached-config fallback and mark the secret decrypt hook as non-blocking for canaries. e.g. `helm upgrade --set secretProvider=fallback-cache --timeout 10m`

samir: patch suggestion for the helm values (canary only): ```yaml
preHook:
  enabled: true
  failOnError: false   # allow startup with cached values
secretProvider: cache
```

jules: Also patch terraform so nodepool creation is decoupled from sealed-secrets rollout. Add `depends_on` on `kubernetes_deployment.sealed_secrets` to avoid race.

mira: Longer term: two fixes: 1) add retry/backoff to vault-agent TLS connections, 2) reconcile sealed-secrets controller version across clusters so payload formats match.

samir: quick step plan: 1) pause autoscaling in eu-west1 (done by me) 2) CI change to non-blocking hook (PR open: infra/ci#412) 3) redeploy sealed-secrets with compatible certs in staging (scheduled)

ops-jen: ping finance: I put a hold on autoscale autosnap until we confirm cost impact.

mira: leaving this thread with the checklist: - monitor vault-agent login success rate - validate helm canary with secretProvider=cache - run terraform plan against staging to surface any drift - schedule sealed-secrets controller upgrade window - postmortem if it hits prod :thumbsup:

samir: adding logs and helm dumps to the PR for context. if anyone sees an urgent failure ping @oncall.
